name: send_later
description: Schedule a message to be delivered back into THIS SESSION at a future time. The message arrives as an ordinary user turn, so you can use it to remind yourself to resume work, check on something, or continue after a delay. Delivery survives container restarts. Granularity is one minute. Thin wrapper over create_trigger (a self-bind + run_once_at Routine); the returned trigger_id can be passed to delete_trigger to cancel before it fires.

message.description: The text to deliver as a user turn. Write it assuming your current conversation context — this session continues, it does not start fresh.

at.description: RFC3339 timestamp for the fire time (e.g. 2026-04-20T17:00:00Z). Must be in the future. Mutually exclusive with 'delay_minutes'.

delay_minutes.description: Fire this many minutes from now. Minimum 1. Mutually exclusive with 'at'.
